ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: PepperedApron uses the camera to add a photo to your recipes, read a printed or handwritten recipe, a receipt, or the barcode of a product in your pantry.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PepperedApron accesses your photos to illustrate your recipes or import a recipe from an image or your latest screenshot.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: PepperedApron listens to a recipe video you import, the recipe you dictate, or your voice commands in cook mode, on your iPhone. Nothing is sent.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PepperedApron records the recipe you dictate, and in cook mode listens for “next” or “repeat” if you turn voice commands on. Everything stays on your iPhone.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: PepperedApron adds your shopping list to the Reminders list you choose, so it can be shared with your family.
ios.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: PepperedApron adds your shopping list to the Reminders list you choose, so it can be shared with your family.
